name: Stoicism
core_belief: Focus on what you can control, and accept calmly what you cannot.
description: Stoicism teaches that peace of mind comes from focusing your energy only on what you can actually control — your own actions, effort and attitude — and accepting everything else calmly, without wasted anger or panic.

name: Existentialism
core_belief: No one is born with a fixed purpose; you become responsible for the meaning you choose.
description: Existentialism holds that people are not born with a ready-made purpose. You create meaning through the choices you actually make, and you are responsible for owning the consequences of those freely chosen actions.

name: Absurdism
core_belief: The world will not always be fair or make sense, so keep going anyway.
description: Absurdism accepts that the world will not always be fair, predictable or reasonable, no matter how well you plan. Rather than despair, the Absurdist response is to keep going anyway — sometimes even finding humour in it.

name: Nihilism
core_belief: A challenge posed by philosophers: what if nothing has built-in meaning at all?
description: Nihilism is the challenging idea that things may not have any built-in, permanent meaning. In Faust's Deck this is always presented as a question worth thinking about, paired with how other schools of thought would answer it.

name: Utilitarianism
core_belief: Choose the action that creates the greatest good for the greatest number of people.
description: Utilitarianism judges a choice by its overall consequences: the best action is the one that creates the greatest total wellbeing, or the fairest outcome, for the greatest number of people affected — not just for yourself.

name: Hedonism
core_belief: Pleasure and avoiding pain matter, but weigh short-term fun against longer-term regret.
description: Hedonism holds that pleasure and avoiding pain are genuinely important. A wise Hedonist, though, weighs quick, short-term pleasure against the longer-term pain or regret it might cause, and chooses the path with the best overall balance.
